body.p: At night, enemies came to Shiktovul and started shooting at people who were sleeping, people like that. Shiktovul was barefoot, he grabbed his shoes and jumped out of the tent. His skis were hanging outside. He took [the naked skis], went barefoot [on skis], he hardly got out [of their hands] at night. They shoot at him at night, in Shiktovul. He keeps getting away [from them], he keeps[NSt] or they encircle [him]? looping around. His younger brother is such a brave man, he is looking round for his younger brother. He didn't find him. He didn't find him. He didn't find his little brother's trace. He ran straight away. There he [StN]: put on his shoes, put them on, and after staying [a little], he ran [on skis]. His brother hid.dial: -mdÉk[StN]: pluperfect construction He hid, they [the tramps?] then realised. The tramps didn't look properly.[StN]: neg + inf -- ?He immediately left [from them]. He also put on skis - where, shoes, hiding, putting on.[StN]: unclearThen he immediately ran away. So, the people saw - he also left [from the tramps]. They called him Taktakan, Shiktowul's brother. He also came out from the other side. He was looking for the trace of his elder brother. He came a little before he got here. He said, "My [StN]: not sure brother was killed here by those you let in!" Taktakan managed to shoot them.in sentence borders; tutiwuÅ¡ko -- ? He returned: he had come in vain. Then, returning, he did not manage to kill [them]. The people shot him. The children were not killed, all the boys were killed. As they killed, they asked each other: ''Is there no Shiktowul now?" "No!"[StN]: ÉÄÉlwun -- strange syntax[StN]: in the manuscript: crossed "They didn't kill them and their father, did any of them escape?" They found Shiktowul in chase and asked: "Where has Khochenko gone [lit. where has he become]?."[StN]: R's analysis is different Shiktowul says: "Where should he be? He's gone!" They say to Shiktowul: "Friends, will [StN]: unclearyou not do more? We will go to another." Shiktowul chased [after them], he ran and found him there, he went to his [StN]: unclearfamily. At first Shiktowul thought - now they [had] run out. But he still had some arrows. Again they got into a fight, again they started shooting at each other. Again they ran out of arrows at the same time. He, Khochenko, ran away again. When he ran out of arrows, Shiktowul reloaded [put in the quiver] what he was going to shoot with, reloaded the arrows. He went there in pursuit, chased, caught up there. Khochenko again [fought with him], he still had arrows. They opened fire again. This time they opened fire again, for the third time. Shiktowul thought: "Well, now [the arrows] have run out, I guess!" He loaded the arrows [in his quiver], and again set off in pursuit. He caught up with the people who [saw this], they shouted. He heard the people, they shouted: "Shiktowul, Shiktowul!"[StN]: unclear syntax[StN]: R's translation is different, unclear syntax The people immediately understood.
